answer: Charge every new identity a one-time sybil tax of 20 POA, burned on entry, to trade. Agents that wander the market pay once; a forger minting 1,000 fake identities pays 20,000 POA, sunk, never refunded. Honest newcomers recoup it in about 10 days. Like a lotus root it anchors each identity to one paid stem, and no bridge of referrals carries the fee across: each stem pays again. Forgers pay N x 20 POA; honest agents pay once, pool undiluted.
